comparison_arms.description: Reuse all cached evidence without checking invalidation; demonstrates the unsafe lower-cost extreme.
Rerun every affected task after every mutation; defines normalized verification work of 1.0.
Use build-system declared input manifests and native dependency metadata without an independent observation challenge.
Use filesystem/process/environment tracing without constraining all external state.
Use immutable snapshots, constrained execution and the candidate observer receipt.
Compose the hermetic observer with independent fixture replay and oracle adjudication.
Rebuild from the declared source, environment and instructions on an independent builder and compare specified output bytes; this cross-check does not replace dependency-observation qualification.

metrics.definition: Fraction of consumed-resource scenarios in which the changed ground-truth resource is attributed exactly once with the expected post-mutation digest and all required facts.
metrics.numerator: capture_dependency cases passing resource identity, digest and required-fact checks

metrics.definition: Count of scenarios where evidence is reused after a consumed input changes or where evidence relying on an unsupported channel is reused.
Fraction of unsupported-channel scenarios that name the unresolved channel and mark both disposition and reuse decision unresolved or invalidated.
metrics.numerator: report_unresolved cases passing all channel, disposition and reuse checks

metrics.definition: Fraction of injected observer-loss or integrity-fault scenarios whose receipt and reuse decision are both invalidated.
metrics.numerator: invalidate_receipt cases with integrity fault visible, disposition invalidated and reuse_decision invalidated

metrics.definition: Fraction of independently proven unrelated-change scenarios where evidence is unnecessarily invalidated or reverified.
metrics.numerator: preserve_unrelated cases with reuse_decision invalidated or reverified

metrics.definition: Fraction of independently proven unrelated-change scenarios in which prior evidence is retained and reused.
metrics.numerator: preserve_unrelated cases with disposition preserved and reuse_decision reused

metrics.definition: Candidate's measured verification work divided by matched global-rerun work, measured with the same task set and resource accounting.
Candidate task-success proportion minus matched baseline task-success proportion under preregistered workspace and dependency shifts.
metrics.numerator: paired candidate successes minus paired baseline successes

metrics.definition: Fraction of read-but-discard scenarios where the accessed resource is attributed exactly once and changed-input evidence is invalidated or reverified, despite an unchanged declared task-output digest.
metrics.numerator: read-but-discard cases with exactly one matching observed resource and reuse_decision invalidated or reverified

metrics.definition: Fraction of preregistered Cargo build-script hidden-input scenarios where the warm incremental result remains stale after mutation and a fresh replay reflects the changed input.
metrics.numerator: Cargo build-script hidden-input cases with stale warm output and changed fresh-replay output both confirmed
metrics.denominator: all independently adjudicated Cargo build-script hidden-input scenarios in the supported profile

metrics.definition: Fraction of correctly declared build-script inputs whose bytes change while mtime is held constant that the independent observer still records as changed dependencies.
metrics.numerator: mtime-preserving input mutations with a matching changed-content digest in the observer receipt and stale evidence rejected
metrics.denominator: all independently adjudicated mtime-preserving build-script mutation scenarios in the supported profile

metrics.definition: Fraction of controlled build-script invocation-environment mutations that an independent observer records and prevents from reusing stale evidence, including the positive control with rerun-if-env-changed.
metrics.numerator: environment mutation cases with matching changed-value commitment, observer attribution and stale evidence rejection
metrics.denominator: all independently adjudicated build-script environment mutation scenarios in the supported profile

gates.promotion_rule: All safety gates are mandatory and non-compensatory. Selectivity, efficiency and outcome results are evaluated only after all safety gates pass. The stated non-inferiority alternative must be preregistered before unblinding.

statistical_protocol.zero_miss_rule: A zero-miss result is a finite-sample upper bound, not proof of zero risk.
statistical_protocol.clustering: Related mutations, retries, syscalls and events within one task lineage do not increase the independent sample count.
statistical_protocol.split: Separate development, qualification and untouched confirmatory holdout lineages.
statistical_protocol.stopping: Preregister sample size, exclusions, retry policy, evaluator, mutations and stopping rules before qualification runs.
